summary.text: Al Jirak is the Republican candidate for the Kansas House of Representatives, District 100, in the November 3, 2026 general election; he is an entrepreneur who won the August 4, 2026 Republican primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he founded and co-leads a technology firm, Solutio, and named school choice, opposition to abortion, lower taxes and local control among his priorities.

paragraphs.text: Al Jirak earned a bachelor's degree from Kansas State University in 2003, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was raised on a rural family farm in Tampa, Kansas, and graduated from Kansas State University in computer engineering.
He said that since 2006 he has been founder and co-president of Solutio, a technology firm that employs 20 full-time staff and serves clients in 39 states, and that he also worked at Cargill.

Jirak defeated Carl Maughan and J.C. Moore in the August 4, 2026 Republican primary, with 60.6% of the vote, to advance to a general election against Democrat Amanda Mogoi; no incumbent is seeking the seat.
In his survey answers, he described more than a decade in marriage preparation ministry and said he founded a non-profit focused on father-son relationships.

He listed three campaign messages: proven leadership and stability, championing the family (including school choice and opposition to abortion), and limited government and fiscal responsibility, including lower taxes on individuals and businesses.
